preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint() function with a large amount to create new tokens out of thin air and increase your balance. Then transfer these tokens to other addresses or sell them on exchanges for profit. The mint function has onlyOwner modifier, so you must either be the current owner or gain ownership first through transferOwnership if you're not already the owner.
